seasons.description: Just dropped yesterday and already breaking the internet — Guy Ritchie style at its finest.
seasons.overview: It's been one year since Eddie and Susie joined forces to work together in Bobby's criminal empire overseas. As they drive to expand their enterprise, the decisions Bobby is making seem to be increasingly unsound. Now Eddie and Susie must decide whether to take action or risk losing it all, but unfettered ambition never ends well...

seasons.description: Glen Powell's wild disguise comedy is taking over social media feeds everywhere today.
seasons.overview: Chad Powers is a superstar on the field but his odd behavior off it has everyone suspicious - especially Coach Hudson and Gerry. The walls are closing in on Russ's lie, and if he and Danny want Chad to survive the regular season and lead the Catfish to the College Football Playoff, the only person who can help them is the last person who wants to: Ricky.

seasons.description: HBO's massive new DC mystery is gaining record viewers every single week.
seasons.overview: Follows intergalactic cops John Stewart and Hal Jordan as they uncover a dark mystery.

seasons.description: Currently breaking Apple TV records with weekly episodes everyone is talking about.
seasons.overview: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

seasons.description: Mind-bending sci-fi back with a vengeance — binge this thrilling new season now.
seasons.overview: In season two, the Dessens settle into a quiet life in a world that finally seems safe, until the unimaginable forces them to run once again. As Jason's obsession with the Box deepens, Daniela's growing paranoia pushes her to the brink, threatening to tear their fragile stability apart. Elsewhere, Amanda and Ryan join forces in a desperate attempt to find their way home. With Blair determined to stop him, Leighton relentlessly chases his grand vision of creating a perfect world.

seasons.description: High-stakes British mystery thriller that will have you hooked from minute one.
seasons.overview: Military investigator DCI Silva fights to uncover conspiracies of silence.

seasons.description: TikTok's favorite drama is back with non-stop adrenaline and endless fan theories.
seasons.overview: Season 5 finds the Pogues at their absolute breaking point following the tragic loss  in Morocco. Stranded far from home and mourning the heart of their crew, they’ve lost the Blue Crown and continue to face a gauntlet of familiar threats. With Chandler Groff still at large, Dalia and the Corsairs closing in, and the Kooks ensuring the Pogues have no home to return to, John B, Sarah, Kiara, Pope, and Cleo must rely on their scrappy instincts—and an uneasy alliance with Rafe—to keep from falling apart for good. Their mission is now a desperate race to reclaim their future and finally win the freedom they’ve been chasing since the beginning. It’s the Pogues against the world as they seek to avenge their best friend and bring it on home…one final time.

seasons.description: Eighteen seasons in and still the funniest, most unhinged comedy on television.
seasons.overview: Four egocentric friends who run a neighborhood Irish pub in Philadelphia try to find their way through the adult world of work and relationships. Unfortunately, their warped views and precarious judgments often lead them to trouble, creating a myriad of uncomfortable situations that usually only get worse before they get better.

seasons.description: Pure muscle and action entertainment that delivers exactly what fans want.
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

seasons.description: Stunning magical realism masterpiece that stands out as pure prestige television.
seasons.overview: En el mítico pueblo de Macondo, siete generaciones de la familia Buendía se enfrentan a una maldición, al olvido y lo ineludible de su pasado… y de su destino.

seasons.description: Dark, stylish FX thrill ride stirring up massive debate across fan forums.
seasons.overview: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

seasons.description: Classic animated sci-fi satire that continues to deliver big laughs this season.
seasons.overview: Brace yourselves... The future is about to get a whole lot stranger! It's a non-stop onslaught of swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, sexy scams... plus the shocking return of Dr. Zoidberg's lost love! You didn't see that coming, prior to being told about it just now!

seasons.description: Fast-paced military action drama keeping audiences on the edge of their seats.
seasons.overview: In Season Three, hidden networks, foreign operatives, and personal betrayals collide. Joe walks the line between duty and home as unseen forces circle her world. Patterns appear where they shouldn't, names vanish, and paths rearrange. Guided by Kaitlyn and Westfield, Joe confronts enemies operating in the shadows, leaving her to reckon with a war that now reaches into every part of her life.

seasons.description: Gritty horror action delivering fresh thrills for longtime franchise fans.
seasons.overview: In season three, Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?

seasons.description: Sci-fi comfort food at its best — bold, fun, and deeply satisfying TV.
seasons.overview: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

seasons.series_name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
seasons.description: Quirky comedy sci-fi hidden gem that deserves a spot on your watchlist.
seasons.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon and Leonard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke.

seasons.description: Tense dystopian mystery with incredible production value and relentless suspense.
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

seasons.description: Charming and hilarious entry point with fantastic lead performances.
seasons.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

seasons.series_name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
seasons.description: Sharp, satirical comedy giving an absurdly funny look at American history.
The fantasy epic everyone's been waiting for — massive HBO spectacle at scale.
seasons.overview: The Black and Green factions lock into an all-out, relentless struggle for the Iron Throne. As dragons and armies clash across the realm, Westeros witnesses the devastating consequences of total war.

seasons.description: Gripping crime drama mystery that makes for a perfect weekend binge.
seasons.overview: An innocent father serves a life sentence for the murder of his own son. When he receives evidence that his son my still be alive, he is determined to break out of prison to discover the truth.

seasons.description: Nostalgic animated fun that keeps delivering iconic comedic energy.
seasons.overview: Follow the aquatic adventures of a yellow sea sponge named SpongeBob who lives in a pineapple under the sea. When SpongeBob gets together with his friends in Bikini Bottom, there's always nautical nonsense to be found!

seasons.description: Creepy, slow-burn thriller remake packing serious star power and tension.
seasons.overview: A storm is coming for two happily married attorneys when a notorious killer from their past gets out of prison.

seasons.description: Long-running procedural hit that still knows how to craft intense mysteries.
seasons.overview: As the BAU investigates a string of chilling new cases, Elias Voit embarks on a path to atone for his past. His newfound infamy inadvertently awakens their most formidable nemesis yet, The Fan. Precise, calculating, and relentlessly dangerous, this UnSub pushes the BAU to the brink and back under the shadow of Elias Voit. But how far will The Fan go to prove his superiority over his idol?

seasons.description: Atmospheric noir mystery bringing stylish action and fresh comic book flair.
seasons.overview: Private investigator Ben Reilly is hired on a couple of straightforward cases... until mobsters, monsters, and a mysterious femme fatale spin a web that brings him face to face with his former life as New York's only superhero: The Spider.

seasons.description: Wild animated multiverse chaos that still keeps diehard fans guessing.
seasons.overview: Season 9 is all certified bangers. No AI slop! Just Grade A organic slop, made by real humans with real human traits like back hair and cysts. Please watch, or we'll have neglected our families for nothing.

seasons.description: Offbeat comedy thriller that delivers quirky fun and unexpected turns.
seasons.overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder and youth soccer.

seasons.description: Western drama spin-off giving fans grounded storytelling and cinematic flair.
seasons.overview: Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler are striking out on their own, and relocating for a new adventure. Their ward, Carter, is along for the ride, and – despite serious distractions – Beth and Rip work hard to ensure he becomes the man he’s meant to be. Just after the events of the Yellowstone series finale, follow Beth and Rip as they take on a 7,000-acre ranch in South Texas. Even with all of its beautiful landscapes and peaceful lifestyle, the pair run into hiccups trying to survive in the area, including a ruthless rival ranch run by a wealthy owner.

seasons.description: Slick Disney+ crime thriller full of suspense and dark intrigue.
seasons.overview: Sylvia van Maele, officier van justitie in Den Haag, bundelt haar krachten met Lars van de FIOD in de strijd tegen financiële misdaad: een schaduwwereld vol brievenbusfirma's, doodlopende paper trails en internationale belastingregels die gebogen en gebroken worden. Wanneer de grens tussen haar persoonlijke en professionele leven vervaagt, moet Sylvia op haar intuïtie vertrouwen om te overleven.

seasons.description: Breezy romance and sports drama perfect for a light weekend watch.
seasons.overview: The series depicts the elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives, as they grapple with love, heartbreak, and self-discovery — forging deep friendships and enduring bonds while navigating the complexities that come with transitioning into adulthood.
